summary.text: REINS MASKINERING AS is a private limited company registered in Husnes, founded 2000-01-13. REINS MASKINERING AS is a machining workshop engaged in production, purchase and sale of goods and services, and everything connected to this. Its main industry code is 25.530: machining of metals. The register shows 26 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 49 614 312 NOK and the annual result was 1 048 188 NOK; operating income was up from 46 830 827 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 2 462 361 NOK in 2024 to 1 048 188 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 7 515 928 NOK in 2024 to 8 564 116 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is reins.no, which links to its Facebook profile. The registered employee count went from 27 on 2025-12-13 to 26 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
